'''Presentation''' was a month-long festival on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] that occurred during the summer. Among other things, it gave the native [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] a chance to gain admission to the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], a group of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] stranded on the planet in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]]. There was also a [[Uvak competition|competition]] for the Tribe's youth to obtain a [[uvak]], a [[Reptavian/Legends|winged reptilian]] creature that could be used for transportation. In [[37 ABY]], [[Sith Tyro]] [[Vestara Khai]] was one of the children to successfully obtain a uvak.
